name: hidx_rootctl_am_1018-r1-COMMIT

One clock pin (the 8 IDX ctl clock nets were the same stream clock; tile < 0.5 mm), rst_n -> ot_rst_relay 3 regions. First hardening of idx_ctl (no view existed: GEN0/GEN1 bound SYNTH).
